result.description:
Farnese Australia Pty Ltd. is seeking a full Time Service Technician to join our team based in Ingleburn NSW.

Reporting to the Services Manager, this is a hands-on, permanent role where you will play a key part in machine installations, preventive and breakdown maintenance. You will work across mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems, servicing machinery such as CNC Machine Centres, Bridge Saws, Block Saws, and Jib / Gantry Cranes.
This role offers variety and the opportunity to work both autonomously and within a team. While qualifications are not essential, any mechanical or electrical aptitude will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities:
•	Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance of machinery.
•	Install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Install and service equipment, including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic components.
•	Interpret electrical drawings and perform diagnostic checks.
•	Liaise with clients to understand and address service requirements.

What We Offer:
•	A permanent, full-time role in a supportive team environment.
•	A company vehicle for both work and personal use.
•	Opportunity for hands-on, technical work with diverse, cutting edge equipment.

Essential Criteria
•	Ability to interpret electrical and mechanical concepts and drawings.
•	Ability to install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Previous experience in machinery preventive maintenance.
•	Strong mechanical aptitude and fault-finding skills.
•	Excellent communication and client liaison skills.
•	Reliable work ethic with attention to detail and accuracy.
•	Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
•	Current driver's licence.
•	Minimum of less than 1 year of machinery preventive maintenance experience required.
•	Ability to interpret basic electrical symbols and drawings required.

Desirable Criteria:
•	Electrical fault-finding experience.
•	Knowledge of electrical control systems.
•	Experience with CNC machine technology and operation.
•	Background in the stone industry, manufacturing, or machinery service.

Renumeration: $85,000 - $105,000 + Super for the right candidate.

If you are looking for a hands-on, technically challenging role with the potential to grow and expand your skill set, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and become an integral part of our team at Farnese Australia.

result.description:
La Riviera Dining
Wine & Dine Australia Pty Ltd, trading as Bambini Trust Restaurant
Sydney NSW 2000

Café or Restaurant Manager
Full Time Role
Salary Range $77,000 to $80,000 per annum, plus superannuation.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
1. Operational Management
•	Coordinate daily front-of-house operations, including service setup, staff briefings, and shift supervision. 
•	Ensure smooth collaboration between front-of-house and kitchen teams. 
•	Maintain service standards consistent with the La Riviera brand. 
•	Monitor and improve operational procedures to ensure efficient restaurant operations and high levels of customer satisfaction. 
2. Staff Leadership and Development
•	Coordinate staff recruitment, onboarding and performance management processes. 
•	Plan and deliver training programs focused on guest service, product knowledge and teamwork. 
•	Contribute to building a positive and high-performing workplace culture. 
•	Prepare staff rosters and supervise staff to ensure adequate staffing levels during operating hours. 
3. Guest Experience and Customer Service
•	Manage reservations, guest interactions and special requests. 
•	Handle feedback and complaints with professionalism and discretion. 
•	Participate in the delivery of VIP and high-profile guest experiences. 
•	Monitor customer feedback and implement service improvements to enhance the overall guest experience. 
4. Wine Room and Beverage Coordination
•	Work alongside the Sommelier to oversee wine service, pairing and cellar management. 
•	Coordinate wine and beverage training for staff. 
•	Manage inventory checks and beverage ordering. 
•	Monitor beverage stock levels and ensure appropriate inventory control procedures are maintained. 
5. Financial and Administrative Support
•	Monitor sales performance and implement cost control measures. 
•	Oversee the use of point-of-sale and booking systems. 
•	Manage back-office administrative functions, including timesheet collection and supplier invoicing. 
•	Assist in preparing operational reports and monitoring labour costs to support business profitability. 
6. Compliance and Workplace Safety
•	Ensure compliance with NSW food safety and liquor licensing laws. 
•	Conduct risk assessments and implement workplace health and safety initiatives. 
•	Ensure safe service practices are followed during operations and events. 
•	Monitor compliance with company policies and relevant legislative requirements. 
7. Supplier and Inventory Management
•	Manage stock ordering, deliveries and supplier communications. 
•	Conduct regular stocktakes and identify opportunities to minimise waste. 
•	Ensure quality control of incoming goods and supplies. 
•	Maintain appropriate stock levels to support uninterrupted restaurant operations. 
8. Events and Marketing Support
•	Contribute to the planning and execution of events, such as private dinners and cocktail functions. 
•	Coordinate the promotion of wine tastings, seasonal menus and customer engagement activities. 
•	Monitor customer feedback and participate in continuous improvement discussions. 
•	Work with management to implement promotional initiatives that enhance customer engagement and increase revenue. 


Qualifications
•	A relevant qualification in Hospitality Management, Restaurant Management, Business Management or a related field (such as an AQF Certificate IV, Diploma or Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management) is desirable. 
•	Alternatively, at least three years of relevant full-time industry experience in restaurant or hospitality management may substitute for formal qualifications, where applicable. 
•	Current Food Safety Supervisor Certificate (or the ability to obtain one). 
•	Current Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) Certificate. 
•	First Aid Certificate is desirable. 

Work Experience
•	At least two years of full-time experience in a managerial role, or three years of relevant experience, in a café, restaurant or similar hospitality establishment. 
•	Demonstrated experience managing the day-to-day operations of a restaurant or café, including front-of-house operations. 
•	Experience recruiting, supervising, training and managing the performance of staff. 
•	Experience managing customer service, resolving guest complaints and maintaining high service standards. 
•	Experience preparing staff rosters, managing inventory, ordering supplies and maintaining stock control. 
•	Experience monitoring food quality, operational efficiency and compliance with food safety and workplace health and safety requirements. 
•	Experience monitoring budgets, labour costs, sales performance and implementing cost control measures. 
•	Experience coordinating private functions, special events or promotional activities is desirable. 
•	Sound knowledge of Australian hospitality legislation, food safety standards and liquor licensing requirements.


How to apply:
Applications open on 21 July 2026 and close on 20 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

result.description:
Our client, Tech Envision, is a technology solutions provider located in Warrnambool, Victoria, specialising in telecommunications, networking, information technology (IT) infrastructure, and digital technology services. The company delivers end-to-end solutions including network design, telecommunications system deployment, infrastructure implementation, technical support, and ongoing maintenance for business clients. 

Tech Envision is seeking a Telecommunications Field Engineer to install, commission, maintain, troubleshoot, and support telecommunications and network infrastructure at customer sites. The role involves delivering field engineering services, ensuring reliable network performance, resolving technical issues, and providing high-quality customer support while complying with industry standards and safety requirements.

The annual salary for this position is $75,000 to $85,000.

Duties include:

•	Conduct site surveys to assess customer requirements, network infrastructure, equipment locations, and installation feasibility for telecommunications projects. 

•	Install, configure, commission, and test telecommunications equipment, including routers, switches, wireless devices, fibre optic systems, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) solutions, and network hardware to meet technical specifications. 

•	Perform fault diagnosis, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on telecommunications networks and associated equipment to ensure continuous service availability. 

•	Monitor network performance using diagnostic tools and protocol analysers, identifying faults and implementing technical solutions to optimise system reliability and efficiency. 

•	Configure Internet Protocol (IP) networking, routing, switching, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), Virtual Private Networks (VPNs), and wireless communication systems in accordance with customer requirements and industry standards. 

•	Conduct fibre optic cable testing, splicing verification, signal measurements, and certification using specialised test equipment to ensure network integrity and performance. 

•	Prepare technical documentation, including installation reports, network diagrams, test results, maintenance records, and equipment configuration details for project completion and compliance purposes. 

•	Provide onsite technical support and troubleshooting for customers, resolving hardware, software, connectivity, and telecommunications service issues within agreed service levels. 

•	Coordinate with Project Managers, Network Engineers, vendors, and customers during installation, commissioning, upgrades, and maintenance activities to ensure successful project delivery. 

•	Ensure all telecommunications installations and field activities comply with workplace health and safety requirements, telecommunications regulations, and company quality standards. 

•	Perform system upgrades, firmware updates, equipment replacements, and network expansion activities with minimal disruption to customer operations. 

•	Assist in evaluating new telecommunications technologies, conducting field testing and performance validation, and recommending improvements to enhance network capability, reliability, and customer service outcomes.

Qualifications:

•	Must have at least one (1) year of experience.

•	Should hold a Diploma or higher qualification in a relevant field.

result.description:
About the role
Pitstop Truck and Tyre Repairs is looking for an experienced Diesel Mechanic to join our team in Craigieburn. We specialise in the full spectrum of truck and tyre servicing, from scheduled maintenance through to complex mechanical overhauls, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of precision and workmanship on every job.
This role suits an experienced diesel mechanic who is comfortable working across a range of heavy vehicles and wants to be part of a workshop that takes quality seriously. You will work on real trucks with real complexity, not light vehicles dressed up as diesel work.

Key responsibilities
- Diagnose faults across heavy diesel engines, fuel systems, turbochargers, air brake systems, and driveline components using both hands-on inspection and computer-based diagnostic tools
- Dismantle and remove engine assemblies, transmissions, differentials, steering mechanisms, and ancillary systems for inspection and repair
- Repair and replace worn or defective components, including fuel injectors, common rail systems, exhaust aftertreatment components (DPF, SCR, AdBlue), and turbo units, referencing OEM service manuals throughout
- Reassemble engines and mechanical components to manufacturer specifications following repair
- Carry out scheduled servicing including oil and filter changes, brake adjustments, lubrications, and engine tune-ups to maintain compliance and vehicle performance
- Perform post-repair testing and adjustment to confirm correct operation before vehicles are returned to service
- Inspect vehicles and assess roadworthiness, detailing required remedial work where applicable
- Maintain accurate job records and service documentation

About you
- Experience working on diesel-powered vehicles or equipment in a professional workshop or field environment
- Competent with electronic diagnostic tools and fault-finding processes
- Sound knowledge of diesel engine systems and related mechanical components
- High attention to detail with a methodical approach to fault diagnosis and repair
- Able to manage multiple jobs concurrently and work efficiently in a fast-paced workshop
- Current driver's licence required; additional licensing may be required depending on the role
- Roadworthy certification authority desirable but not essential

 Department of Health

 Applications must be submitted by Sunday 02 August, 2026 11:55 PM 




Position details




 

 

 
Applications close:

 
Sunday 2 August, 2026 11:55 PM AEST

 

 

 
Award-Classification:

 
Nurses and Midwives (Tasmanian State Service) Award, Registered Nurse, Grade 5

$109,767 to $115,813 per annum


 
 

 
Employment type:

 
Fixed-term, full-time

 

 

 
Region:

 
South

Job description:

 
Join a dynamic multidisciplinary team delivering mental health assessments and connecting Tasmanians with the right support services when they need them most.

 

 






 

Please note this position is also being advertised as an Allied Health Professional-Head to Health Phone Service (530940) and only one position will be filled on merit. 
Please note this position is eligible for a Multi-Disciplinary Allowance.

The Team

The Central Intake and Referral Service, including the Medicare Mental Health (formerly Head to Health) phone service, was developed as a single, statewide intake and assessment phone service that integrates with Tasmania's existing state-based systems.

Working in a multidisciplinary environment, the Central Intake and Referral Service collaborates with healthcare providers and community partners to deliver timely, coordinated, and person-centred support, improving access and outcomes for the Tasmanian community.

The Role

Ensure the delivery of a comprehensive clinical service through relevant assessment and refer individuals to appropriate services according to their identified level of care.

Provision of evidence-based assessment for clients with mental health problems and AOD concerns, that are in line with the Tasmanian Governments Rethink Initiative and the National Safety and Quality Health Service Standards.

Actively participate as a member of a multidisciplinary team including the provision of support and consultation to other team members as required.

You will need

A minimum of two years post graduate employment in a clinical area directly applicable to the Mental Health services such as Child and Adolescent, Adult Community, Inpatient and Extended Treatment or Older Persons Mental Health Service area.

Demonstrated clinical knowledge and understanding of mental health in relation to the Child and Adolescent, Adult Community, Inpatient and Extended Treatment or Older Persons Mental Health Service area with the ability to provide appropriate assessment of mental health problems.

Demonstrated ability to identify, document and appropriately manage clinical risks in accordance with 
relevant policies to ensure safe and effective service delivery.

Note: - Please refer to the Statement of Duties for all the selection criteria of this position to address in your application.

Why Tasmania

The Department of Health Tasmania oversees various hospitals across the state, including the Royal Hobart Hospital, Launceston General Hospital, Northwest Regional Hospital, and Mersey Community Hospital, as well as district hospitals and ambulance services. Additionally, it provides community health, mental health, and primary healthcare services to the Tasmanian community through more than 300 sites.

Tasmania, Australia's only island state, offers unparalleled natural beauty and a luxurious lifestyle. Pursuing your health career in Tasmania's public health system means building strong connections with colleagues and patients. It also means embracing a lifestyle where you can enjoy extraordinary experiences outside of work while making a significant impact on the community during work.

Details of appointment

Fixed term full time, day worker position, working 76 hours per fortnight, commencing as soon as possible until 31 December 2026. 

*notwithstanding hours to be negotiated with the successful applicant.

Applicants should note that, for a period of twelve months from the date of publication, this selection process may be used to fill subsequent or similar full time, part time, and casual vacancies.

Salary

$109,767 to $115,813 per annum. Our Employer 12% superannuation contribution is on top of this amount.

Salary range is in accordance with Nurses and Midwives (Tasmania State Service) Agreement 2023.

In addition, the following allowances calculated on the salaried incremental point may be available:

Post Graduate Allowance of up to 10% based on qualification type

Benefits available to eligible candidates 

A range of leave entitlements, including study leave and Professional Development Support.

Fitness Passport - You, and your family can access 40+ fitness facilities across Tasmania for just $14.50 per week per person, or $28.05 for a family.

Department of Health has achieved the "Carer Accredited Employer Status" providing support to employees with caring responsibilities. (Find out more under the Carer Recognition Act 2023). 

More information about our Employee Benefits can be found here

Eligibility

Successful applicants will be required to meet the essential criteria.

Registered with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia as a Registered Nurse and possess specialist tertiary graduate or post graduate mental health-psychiatric nursing qualification; or completed, prior to the transfer of nurse education to the tertiary sector, an accredited hospital based program that lead to registration as a psychiatric nurse by the relevant nurse regulatory authority within Australia, New Zealand, Canada or the United Kingdom

Working with Vulnerable People Registration

Applicants should note the following criteria are desirable:

Current Driver's Licence
